response.goal: Migrate 6 workflows from Zapier to self-hosted n8n, including a form to Google Sheets, Sheets to Slack alerts, a Stripe payment to an email receipt, and three small Gmail filters, test with the client, and provide a short documentation.

plan.step: Audit existing Zapier workflows and map triggers and actions to n8n nodes
Rebuild the 6 workflows in self-hosted n8n including form, Google Sheets, Slack, Stripe, and Gmail integrations
Test each migrated workflow with the client and verify correct data flow
Hand over a short documentation detailing the n8n workflows

milestones.name: Milestone 1: Workflow Migration and Implementation
milestones.deliverable: All 6 workflows rebuilt in self-hosted n8n

milestones.name: Milestone 2: Testing and Documentation Handover
milestones.deliverable: Workflows tested with the client and short documentation delivered

risks.risk: Self-hosted n8n environment access or permission issues during setup
risks.mitigation: Verify server access and credentials before starting the migration process

risks.risk: Differences in how Zapier and n8n handle specific edge cases or payloads for Stripe and Gmail
risks.mitigation: Review existing Zapier history and thoroughly test each node during the testing phase

questions: Do we have admin access to the self-hosted n8n instance and all relevant third-party accounts (Stripe, Gmail, Slack, Google Sheets)?
Are there any specific error handling or notification rules required for failed executions?
assumptions: The client will provide credentials and access to the self-hosted n8n instance and connected applications
The total budget is $450 fixed price
